features.name: OKR Module Restrictions
features.description: Restrict OKR to Organization + Institution + Department levels. Deprecate learner-specific OKR tables.
test_steps: Navigate to /okr - verify dashboard shows only org/institution/department OKRs
Click 'Create Objective' - verify only tier_1 and tier_2 available
Verify level dropdown shows only organization, institution, department
Navigate to /okr/elective/any-id - verify deprecation notice shown
Verify sidebar has no elective/learner OKR menu items
Create an institution-level OKR - verify it saves and appears in list

features.name: Competency Catalog Module
features.description: New module for defining skill taxonomy using Fink's Taxonomy. Includes catalog CRUD, program mapping, course mapping, and learner tracking.
database_changes: Tables created: competency_catalog, competency_program_mapping, course_competency_mapping, learner_competencies
RLS enabled, indexes created, updated_at triggers added
known_issues: FIXED: All type mismatches resolved - build passes cleanly
DONE: Browser tested - full CRUD workflow verified (create, list, detail, edit, archive, restore)
test_steps: Fix build errors and verify npm run build passes
Navigate to /competency-catalog - verify list page loads
Verify sidebar shows 'Competency & Outcomes' group with 'Competency Catalog' item
Click 'Create Competency' - verify form loads with all sections
Fill form: code=TECH-001, name=Python Programming, type=technical
Set Fink's dimensions (6 sliders), AI resistance score, industry tags
Set proficiency levels with descriptions and criteria
Submit form - verify redirect to list and new entry appears
Click on created competency - verify detail page with all tabs
Verify Fink's radar chart renders correctly
Click Edit - verify form pre-filled with existing data
Update name and save - verify changes reflected

features.name: Course Enhancements
features.description: Add learning hours breakdown and competency coverage to courses table.
database_changes: ALTER courses: add learning_hours_target, self_study_hours, practical_hours, theory_hours, competency_coverage (JSONB)
test_steps: Verify new fields appear (hours breakdown, competency coverage)
Save course with new fields - verify data persists
Verify course detail shows hours and competency info

features.name: Learner Profile Capabilities
features.description: Add capabilities, career aspirations, industry readiness score to learner profiles.
database_changes: ALTER learners_profiles: add capabilities (JSONB), career_aspirations (JSONB), industry_readiness_score (NUMERIC), portfolio_url (TEXT)
test_steps: Add a competency to learner - verify it saves

features.name: Staff Facilitator Role
features.description: Add facilitator role type and outcome metrics to staff profiles.
database_changes: ALTER staff: add role_type (VARCHAR), facilitator_certification (JSONB), outcome_metrics (JSONB)
test_steps: Verify role_type dropdown (teacher, facilitator, trainer, industry_mentor, hybrid)

features.name: Attendance Learning Engagement
features.description: Add engagement score and learning behaviors to attendance data. Required for practicals, optional for lectures.
database_changes: No schema change (JSONB structure enhancement in attendance_data)
test_steps: Select a practical/lab period - verify engagement score input is REQUIRED
Select a lecture period - verify engagement score is OPTIONAL
Mark attendance with engagement data - verify saves
Verify learning behaviors can be selected from predefined list

features.name: Billing Outcome-Linked Discounts
features.description: Add outcome-based discount criteria linked to competency achievements.
database_changes: ALTER billing_discounts: add is_outcome_based (BOOLEAN), outcome_criteria (JSONB), outcome_verification (JSONB)
test_steps: Toggle 'Outcome-Based' option - verify criteria fields appear
Save discount - verify outcome criteria persists
